max_tire.note: Owners report no rubbing on gentle trails on 18x9 +40 wheels. 275/70R18 (about 33 in) fits the stock 1958 wheels, and an LT275/70R18 KO3 just fits the spare well.
Fits with no rubbing on a First Edition with a 1.5-inch leveling kit and 17x9.5 −12 wheels (Threepiece).
Shown on a 1958 with 17x8 +25 wheels. Needs the mud flaps, crush brackets and front canards removed (they unbolt) and the fender liners reshaped with a heat gun.

items.title: Fuel tube connection can leak
items.summary: The fuel tube connection near the tank can come apart and leak fuel. Dealers add a supplemental clamp or replace the resin tube (Toyota 26TA23/26TB23).

items.title: Combination meter may not show warnings
items.summary: Parts of the 12.3-inch combination meter can go blank at start-up and fail to show some warnings or indicators (FMVSS 101). Toyota put the US total at about 82,000 Toyota and Lexus vehicles (May 2026).

items.title: Panoramic View Monitor camera freeze
items.summary: A software error can freeze or blank the rear camera image in reverse (FMVSS 111).

items.title: Load-capacity modification label (distributor accessories)
items.summary: Gulf States Toyota recall of certain accessorized vehicles, including 2024 Land Cruisers, whose load-capacity labels were missing or wrong (FMVSS 110).

tsbs.title: Front brake squeal / moan at low speed and in reverse
tsbs.summary: New pads, shims and a revised anti-rattle spring on the front calipers; owners report rotors aren't replaced.

timeline.change: J250 revealed on 2 August 2023: GA-F frame shared with the 300, electric power steering, full-time 4WD with lockable Torsen centre diff
US launch with the i-Force Max 2.4 L turbo hybrid only, in 1958, Land Cruiser and First Edition grades (First Edition limited to 5,000 for North America)
Model years covered by the combination-meter and camera recalls

New Inked paint, optional raised air intake (not a sealed snorkel), heated and ventilated second-row seats in the Premium Package. Toyota.com lists base MSRPs of $58,180 (1958) and $64,255 (Land Cruiser)
All model years included in the fuel-tube leak recall (26V673000) announced October 2026, so check that it's been done

identify.intro: Three US grades share one powertrain, and the differences are mostly in kit. The badge to check is First Edition, which is easy to copy.

items.body: Round headlights, unpainted plastic body panels, cloth seats and 245/70R18 tires on 18x7 wheels. Toyota lists rear and center locking differentials as standard on the 1958; the Stabilizer Disconnect Mechanism is a Land Cruiser-grade item.

items.head: Land Cruiser grade
items.body: Rectangular headlights, painted panels, heated and ventilated front seats, wider 265/70R18 tires, rear locker and stabilizer disconnect. The Premium Package brings 20-inch wheels.

items.head: First Edition
items.body: 2024 only. Limited to 5,000 for North America, it combines the round headlights with a factory roof rack, rock rails and front skid plate. Check the window sticker or build sheet.

items.head: Name confusion
items.body: In the US and much of Europe it's just 'Land Cruiser'. Japan calls it the Land Cruiser 250, and Australia and other markets keep the Prado name. The Lexus GX 550 is the same platform.

capability.v: 6,000 lb (2,720 kg) braked / 1,650 lb (750 kg) unbraked

capability.note: Owner's manual vehicle capacity weight, varies with seating, moonroof and stabilizer disconnect
Wikipedia; KBB lists 8 in minimum for the US 2024
Car and Driver averaged 20 mpg in testing

values.intro: It's still a current model, so MSRP sets the market. Used First Editions sold above sticker at first, and the premium has now gone.
values.note: Base MSRP from Toyota.com (October 2026); CarScoops reported $57,880 for the 1958 when 2027 pricing was announced, and the $1,495 destination charge. Used range from 10 Bring a Trailer sales: First Editions fell from $83,000 (May 2024) to $58,500 (May 2026), and the $91,000 truck was a SEMA-exhibited build.
